          <p class="break-words text-color-text" data-test-id="about-us__description">
              At Environment Southland, we actively enhance the experience of living and working in a sustainable region.  

We are responsible for managing the natural and physical resources of air, land, water and coast for the entire Southland region, which covers over three million hectares from Awarua Point on the West Coast to Waiparau Head on the fringe of the East Coast and includes Stewart Island.

As Southlanders, we owe it to future generations to ensure they continue to enjoy the same environmental standards that we presently value.

Most human activities have an impact on our natural and physical resources. We all have a part to play in making sure that the resources we depend on for our industries, jobs, recreation and quality of life are not over-used.

Twelve democratically elected Councillors are ably supported by more than 150 staff. Councillors must ensure that local needs are met by making decisions and setting the direction for the sustainable use of resources.

How do we achieve a balance in the environment?
We do this in many ways, through environmental standards, communication, education, and consultation. Our aim is to achieve the right balance for Southland's environment in the most reasonable way possible. 

There are many varied roles within Environment Southland, so if you'd like to work for us please check out our vacancies at https://environmentsouthland.recruitmenthub.co.nz/

    <p class="attributed-text-segment-list__content text-color-text !text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words
        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="feed-reshare-content__commentary">Just wrapped up a week with <a class="link" href="https://nz.linkedin.com/company/environment-southland?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Environment Southland</a>, working alongside their inspection team ahead of this season’s annual floodbank inspections.

Did you know <a class="link" href="https://nz.linkedin.com/company/environment-southland?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Environment Southland</a> manages 517km of floodbank network, ranking 3rd in Aotearoa behind only <a class="link" href="https://nz.linkedin.com/company/environment-canterbury?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Environment Canterbury</a> and <a class="link" href="https://nz.linkedin.com/company/waikatoregionalcouncil?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Waikato Regional Council</a>.

The objectives of the week were:
✅ Simplify the inspection process
✅ Improve the mobile inspection form
✅ Increase consistency across the four inspectors

We kicked things off with a whiteboard session, before spending the rest of the week in the field exploring a wide variety of floodbank types and settings, from urban and rural banks, to assets spanning all five condition grades (1–5). We implemented simple techniques to help improve the condition assessment 🔎.

On Day 5 we all headed out together. It was really satisfying to see each inspector independently arriving at the same condition grades and defect severity ratings. The growth in confidence and consistency over just a few days was epic 👏

Big thanks to <a class="link" href="https://nz.linkedin.com/in/stephanie-gray-754b89279?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Stephanie Gray</a> and <a class="link" href="https://nz.linkedin.com/in/jimmy-turnbull-0a6319276?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card_reshare-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Jimmy Turnbull</a> for hosting me. I’m looking forward to hearing about the progress. See you again in three weeks! 👋
